name: SAMPLING DISPENSING BOOTH
desc: Reverse Laminar Air Flow (RALF) Sampling and Dispensing Booth engineered for superior operator protection and containment of powder aerosols. Features an ISO Class 5 cleanroom environment powered by an advanced three-stage filtration setup achieving 99.999% containment down to sub-micron particles.
features: Advanced Heavy-Duty Three Stage multi-barrier filtration core
EU14 grade HEPA Filter tracking at 99.999% down efficiency
Dual 02 Nos. highly accurate analog Differential Pressure Gauges
High-intensity shadowless Fluorescent Lights fitted with Milky White Diffuser

specifications.Equipment Configuration: Reverse Laminar Air Flow (RALF) Sampling and Dispensing Booth Unit
specifications.Air Cleanliness Classification: Certified ISO Class 5 (Class 100 / M 3.5 Area) containment envelope
specifications.Airflow Directional Pattern: Uniform Vertical laminar downflow air distribution pattern
specifications.Chamber Air Velocity Scale: Controlled flow tracking at 0.45 ± 0.05 mps (90 ± 20 FPM)
specifications.Primary Safety Function: Zero risk of operator powder inhalation with absolute micro-particle containment
specifications.Filtration System Assembly: Advanced Heavy-Duty Three Stage multi-barrier filtration core
specifications.Stage 1 Pre-Filter Performance: EU4 grade pre-filtration tracking at 90 percent down efficiency
specifications.Stage 2 Intermediate Filter: EU7 grade secondary filtration tracking at 95 percent down efficiency
specifications.Stage 3 HEPA Filter Array: EU14 grade primary supply and exhaust absolute filtration at 99.999 percent down
specifications.Air Circulation Blower Engine: Statically and dynamically balanced heavy-duty Motor-Blower assembly
specifications.Acoustic Noise Index Profile: Low-noise quiet operations stabilizing under a 65 dB performance threshold
specifications.Vibration Mitigation Matrix: Integrated mechanical anti-vibration rubber isolator system links
specifications.Pressure Monitoring Toolkit: Dual 02 Nos. highly accurate analog Differential Pressure Gauges
specifications.Pressure Gauge Targets: Dedicated real-time monitoring for Intermediate Filter and main HEPA Filter rows
specifications.Chassis Framework Options: High-Grade Stainless Steel (SS-304/SS-316) or heavy GI Powder Coated steel
specifications.Internal Chamber Architecture: Seamless flat side panels integrated with all three sides inner radius coving
specifications.Workplace Illumination Deck: High-intensity shadowless Fluorescent Lights fitted with Milky White Diffuser
specifications.Operator Control System: Industrial rocker ON/OFF switches managing Blower, Fluorescent, and UV loops
specifications.Auxiliary Power Provisions: Integrated 5/15 Amp splash-proof Auxiliary Powder Socket for weighing scales
specifications.Validation Aerosol Interface: Built-in upstream concentration testing Dispersed Oil Particulate (DOP) Port
specifications.Regulatory Audit Paperwork: Complete comprehensive DQ, IQ, OQ, and PQ validation documentation package
specifications.Electrical Power Inputs: Standard 230 V AC, 50 Hz, Single Phase stable electrical line connection
specifications.Warranty Cover Protection: 1 Year Comprehensive On-site Manufacturer Warranty on blower and filter blocks
